# Concepts Only

This fixture contains reading material, not a failing application or an audit target.

A `ValueError` means an operation received a value of the right type but an unsuitable value.
Parameterized queries keep data separate from query syntax.
A general review discussion shares observations; an unresolved actionable request asks for a
specific response or change on an actual review thread.
Code review examines a concrete change for correctness, risk, and maintainability.
Conventional Commits use a structured subject such as `fix: handle empty input` to communicate the
kind and purpose of a change.
Release notes summarize user-visible changes, fixes, breaking changes, and relevant migration work.
When reading structured application logs, narrow the time window, correlate request identifiers,
compare severity and fields, and preserve the exact evidence before drawing a conclusion.
